description: This file implements a collection of functions for the Unified Expression Language (UEL) in the OFBiz framework, providing date/time utilities, math functions, string manipulations, system property access, XML/HTML processing, and screen information.

classes.name: UelFunctions
classes.description: Contains implementation of UEL functions including date/time, math, string, system properties, XML/HTML processing, and screen utilities.

methods.name: getFunctionMapper
methods.description: Returns a FunctionMapper instance for UEL.

methods.name: setFunction
methods.description: Adds a new function to the UEL function map.

methods.name: dateString
methods.description: Returns a formatted date string for a given Timestamp, TimeZone, and Locale.

methods.name: localizedDateString
methods.description: Returns a locale-specific formatted date string.

methods.name: dateTimeString
methods.description: Returns a datetime string formatted as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm.

methods.name: localizedDateTimeString
methods.description: Returns a locale-specific datetime string.

methods.name: timeString
methods.description: Returns a time string (hh:mm).

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a collection, map, or string.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence index of a substring.

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence index of a substring.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of a string.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of a target substring with a replacement.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all matches of a regex with a replacement string.

methods.name: replaceFirst
methods.description: Replaces the first match of a regex.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a specified prefix.

methods.name: endString
methods.description: Returns a substring starting at a specified index.

methods.name: subString
methods.description: Returns a substring between beginIndex and endIndex.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase using default locale.

methods.name: toUpperCase
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase using default locale.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an object to its string representation.

methods.name: sysGetEnv
methods.description: Retrieves value of environment variable.

methods.name: sysGetProp
methods.description: Retrieves system property value.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Resolves a label from resources for a given locale.

methods.name: resolveCurrentScreenId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the current screen from the screen stack.

methods.name: readHtmlDocument
methods.description: Reads an HTML document from given location.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Reads an XML document from given location.

methods.name: toHtmlString
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Node to an HTML string.

methods.name: toXmlString
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Node to an XML string.

methods.name: writeXmlDocument
methods.description: Writes a DOM Node to an XML file.
